entries.description: Register. Read the reservation record (entry 7) and `ai_router/docs/seat-cost.md` before anything else.

**Re-price every session that can be re-priced.** Walk the schema-v4 sets, and for each session read what its `disposition.cost` CLAIMED, then run `seat_cost --retrospective` against the ids the repo already recorded (`orchestrator.seatSessionIds`, `router-metrics.jsonl` `transport_session_id`). Emit a machine-readable report — one row per session, claimed vs measured, per component. **Read-only: nothing in a closed session's record is edited.**

**Classify every gap, and be strict about the middle category.** Three buckets: *recoverable* (a measurement was available and was not taken — Set 113 S8 is the known member), *honestly unmeasurable* (no store, no ids, pre-`seat_cost`), and *asserted-false* (the block states a reason that the evidence contradicts). The third is the one that matters and the one a lazy audit collapses into the second, so it needs a stated test rather than a judgement call.

**Say what the roll-ups were wrong by**, in credits and dollars, with the share of sessions affected — and state plainly what cannot be recovered and why, rather than reporting only the part that could.
**Required portion of the full test suite.**
**Close-out**, mid-set, with a `next_orchestrator` handover — and produce this session's own cost block with `seat_cost`, which is the smallest possible dogfood of the thing being audited.
Registered S1 on github-copilot/claude-opus-5; read reservation entry 7, seat-cost.md, Set 113 s8-remediation-round-3 and its cost adjudication. Transport copilot-cli.
Re-priced 431 sessions from recorded ids; walked all 516 disposition.json versions (47 carry a cost block). cost-audit.json written. Read-only.
Classified by stated tests: 1 asserted-false (113 S8, 2 superseded versions), 5 overclaimed-exact, 8 honest-floor-drift, 4 recoverable, 413 honestly unmeasurable; 7 fabricated-status versions.
cost-audit.md: 16 priceable closed sessions under-report 13,386 credits ($133.86, +27.6%); $3,305.80 of in-repo seat spend claimed by no record; unrecoverable portion named.
Rounds 1-2 discovery+supplementary (gpt-5.5): 2 Major, both accepted and fixed; round 3 remediation-review VERIFIED, 1 accepted, 1 accepted-with-modification, 1 nit closed.
run_of_record affected: no declared suite input set intersects this change (0 paths). Change set is set-directory docs only; nothing owed (A5).
